name: KELL
description: A practical, resourceful member of the emergency radio broadcast team. Kell handles technical equipment and logistics during a crisis, demonstrating problem-solving skills and dry humor under pressure.

explicit_evidence.quote: KELL rushes in carrying a portable antenna, a dented lantern, and a canvas tool bag.
Bridge is closed. Cell towers are dead. The hill relay is our only shot.
It only tried to kill me once.
Comet better be worth interrupting the weather report.
explicit_evidence.source_scene: INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM SHELTER - PRE-DAWN

explicit_evidence.quote: Smart dog. Dry floor, free snacks.
Kell enters with a loaf of warm bread wrapped in foil.

inferred_traits.rationale: Kell arrives prepared with necessary equipment during an emergency, manages technical challenges, and maintains composure while handling critical infrastructure tasks.
Works seamlessly with the radio team, contributes to logistics and problem-solving, and participates in group efforts without conflict or ego.
Focuses on actionable solutions, prioritizes essential tasks (weather reports over pet announcements), and handles physical logistics efficiently.
Uses self-deprecating and situational humor to defuse tension, commenting on equipment and animal behavior with wit rather than complaint.

scene_presence: INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM SHELTER - PRE-DAWN
dialogue_summary: Kell delivers four lines across three scenes. In the radio studio, Kell reports the bridge closure and makes a self-deprecating joke about a cursed antenna. At the shelter, Kell questions whether a missing dog announcement is worth interrupting weather reports. In the morning studio, Kell makes an observational comment about the recovered dog's survival strategy. All dialogue is functional, pragmatic, and tinged with dry humor.

relationships.evidence: Works together in the radio studio on technical equipment and signal management during the emergency broadcast.
Collaborates with June on emergency logistics and shelter operations; June accepts Kell's pragmatic input on broadcast priorities.
Works alongside Aria in the radio studio during emergency broadcast operations.
